title: Do your MW dreams feel like you're stepping into someone else's timeline / life?
content: I am so glad to have found this space and all of you who share this experience. ❤️ My apologies for this long post, as I have so many questions to share. When I sleep, my "arrival" in MW feels like I've opened my eyes and found myself in a fully formed reality with people bustling around me. They all seem to know what's going on - what their purpose is, where they need to go - but my mind feels cloudy and confused. I get kind of swept up into the flow of the activity and have to figure out where I am and what I'm supposed to be doing. It always feels like work. The odd thing is the people I encounter there act like they know ME - that I've been there all along and they are frustrated with me that I suddenly don't know how to do my job or get from point A to B or that I don't just generally know what's going on. I never see myself clearly when I'm in MW. I've often felt that when the me in this timeline slips into the life of someone on a different timeline, and they have vacated their... incarnation?...to also travel elsewhere. The reason people are upset with me is that they think I'm the same person and they think I'm just being odd. I wonder if I look like that person to them. And it's not always the same person - I inhabit different identities that have different jobs and go different places, but I know it's all the same world. (Like it's in a dome or bubble).
